name: zpl-atlas
description: ZPL label files: labels, text fields, structure check. Pro: barcode check with check digits and layout check in millimetres. Works offline.

commands.title: ZPL Atlas: Show Label Structure Check
ZPL Atlas: Remove Licence From This Machine

walkthroughs.title: Get started with ZPL Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample label file, see its labels, text fields and structure check, and try the Pro barcode check and layout check in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
ZPL Atlas reads ZPL, the command language of many thermal label printers. The sample holds two invented warehouse labels with one wrong check digit and one field that falls off the label, so every report has something to show. Open it to follow along, or open a label file of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:zplAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Labels
steps.description:
Every label with its lines, number of fields and barcodes, size in dots and print quantity. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Labels](command:zplAtlas.showLabels)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Text Fields, Show Label Structure Check.
[Show Text Fields](command:zplAtlas.showTextFields)
[Show Label Structure Check](command:zplAtlas.showSyntax)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Barcode Check, Show Layout Check.
[Show Barcode Check](command:zplAtlas.showBarcodes)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:zplAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:zplAtlas.reportProblem)

zplAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

zplAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
